en.headline: Parents in Tuen Mun neglect case released on bail
en.dek: Police said the pair must report back later this month. Social workers have taken three children to hospital for assessment.
body: Two adults arrested over an alleged case of ill-treatment or neglect of a child in their care at Fu Tai Estate in Tuen Mun have been released on bail, police said on Thursday night.

Officers said the pair must report to police later this month. The mother was released in the afternoon after telling officers she felt unwell and was taken to Tuen Mun Hospital, while the other adult left Tuen Mun Police Station at about 9pm, according to reports of the police account.

The Social Welfare Department said it was very concerned and had sent social workers to the family after learning of the case on Wednesday. After a preliminary assessment, the workers arranged for three children to go to hospital, where they remain for health checks.

The department said it is working with other professionals on a follow-up plan, taking account of safety risks, the children's health and development, and the family's ability to care for them. It said it would take measures in the children's best interests.

zh.headline: 屯門富泰邨涉虐兒父母獲准保釋
zh.dek: 警方表示兩人須於本月下旬報到。社署已安排三名子女到醫院接受健康評估。
body: 警方星期四晚表示，兩名因屯門富泰邨一宗涉嫌對所看管兒童或少年人虐待或忽略案件被捕的成年人，已獲准保釋候查。
警方指兩人須於本月下旬向警方報到。報道引述警方說，女童母親下午獲准保釋，惟報稱不適，需送往屯門醫院；另一名成年人約晚上9時離開屯門警署。
社會福利署表示十分關注事件，星期三知悉後已即時派社工接觸涉事家庭及搜集資料。初步評估後，社工安排並陪同三名兒童往醫院接受檢查，他們目前仍在醫院接受健康評估。
社署說，正與相關專業人員評估兒童及家庭需要，並會因應安全風險、兒童健康或發展情況，以及家庭照顧能力制訂跟進計劃。署方表示會採取合適措施，保障兒童的最佳利益。
